summary: v10.8 plug-and-play NeriaCorp publish API tested end-to-end. New test_neriacorp_publish.py (8 tests) covers: configured flag in /apps, unconfigured mock fallback, invalid app 400, non-admin 403, LIVE publish via in-process mock HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:7890 with header verification (Bearer + X-NeriaCorp-Publication-Id + X-NeriaCorp-Admin), unreachable URL → 2-retry backoff fallback, and publications list new fields. All 8 NEW + 14 regression NeriaCorp scanner tests pass (22/22). Frontend admin → NeriaCorp drawer loads cleanly with all 3 source testids (take-photo/upload/upload-video); publish banner CSS (bg-emerald-500/30 live vs bg-white/15 mock) verified by code review.
critical_code_review_comments: adapters.py _real_http_call: retry loop performs initial + MAX_RETRIES = 3 attempts total with backoff 0.5s then 1.0s — code matches doc comment. Confirmed end-to-end via the unreachable-URL test (elapsed ≥ 1.5s).
adapters.py publish_to_app returns dict for unknown target_app but routes/scanner_ai.py guards earlier via get_app_meta → 400. Defensive double-check is fine, no dead code concern.
scanner_ai.py publish_to_target_app correctly orders gates: get_admin_user (FastAPI Depends → 403) BEFORE the target_app validity check (400). Verified.
scanner_ai.py /scanner/apps uses APP_DEFAULTS for ref + get_app_meta('configured') from adapters.py — single source of truth for env state. ✓

Frontend NeriaCorpScannerTab handlePublish handles 3 cases (live success / partial mock warning / mock success) — matches API contract exactly. Banner bg-emerald-500/30 (live) vs bg-white/15 (mock) — verified.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_neriacorp_publish.py (NEW — 8 tests with in-process mock HTTP server + .env restore teardown)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (UI structure + testids verified, live publish e2e not run because it requires real-time LLM scan flow)

seed_data_creation: Test scoped: temporarily writes AEVIS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7890 + AEVIS_API_KEY=test-secret-key-123 into /app/backend/.env, restarts backend, runs live publish test, then unreachable test with HERITIA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1. Session-scoped env_backup fixture restores original .env and restarts backend on teardown — verified clean (grep returned CLEAN).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files now cover NeriaCorp: (1) test_neriacorp_scanner.py = 14 tests for /scanner/apps, /analyze, /analyze-video, /audit. (2) test_neriacorp_publish.py = 8 tests for /scanner/publish (mock/live/retry-fallback/invalid/non-admin), /scanner/apps configured flag, /scanner/publications new fields. The publish live test spins an http.server thread inside the pytest process on 127.0.0.1:7890 and writes/restores /app/backend/.env via supervisor restart. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_neriacorp_publish.py -v. Total runtime ~19s. Frontend NeriaCorp drawer at /admin → 'NeriaCorp Intelligence' → 'Scanner IA Admin-Only' renders correctly with all 3 source buttons. The neriacorp-main-action testid only appears AFTER a successful scan; the publish banner appears only after a publish action. For full e2e of live banner, a real LLM scan + click + mock server combo is needed (~30-60s flow).
